ORDER This is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/ 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in relation to FIR/Crime No.77/2025 registered at Police Station - Lateri, District Vidisha for the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of IPC.
2.
sentences._hearing_file: Devendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is a customer of Ashirwad Micro Finance Ltd. Company, Lateri and had taken a gold loan by pledging his gold to the said finance company.

entities.text: Ashirwad Micro Finance Ltd. Company, Lateri
entities.label: ORG

sentences._hearing_file: Devendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025.json

sentences.text: Lateron there was some internal audit in the said finance company and the gold ornaments pledged by various customers were found to be spurious or substandard quality and in this manner the gold pledged by the present applicant was found to be substandard to the tune of Rs.69,280/-.
sentences._hearing_file: Devendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 June, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is argued that the present applicant can be actually said to be victim in the matter because the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11689 2 MCRC-23934-2025 gold after being pledged was in the possession of the officers of the finance company and officers of the finance company have not been made accused in the matter.

sentences.text: The gold was pledged by him after due scrutiny of purity and weighed by the valuer of the company.

opennyai_summary.12_March_2025__arguments:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he is in custody since 24.02.2025.
It is further submitted that the applicant has not done any kind of manipulation in the jewellery for taking gold loan.
In fact, the jewellery of the applicant was mortgaged by the Bank after getting its evaluation by its evaluator.
The applicant has no role in the matter.
He has no criminal antecedents.
opennyai_summary.12_March_2025__decision:
With these submissions, the applicant prays for grant of bail.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court as and when required.
He shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of CrPC/482(3) of BNSS.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments made by learned counsel for the parties and looking to the fact that the applicant is only the borrower of gold loan and the loan was granted to the applicant after getting evaluation of the jewellery, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
